risks: No real endpoint was contacted, so provider eligibility, selected profile, and recovered Gate N1 remain unresolved for separately authorized downstream work.

OpenAI Responses retains continuation for ordinary function-call output items while Anthropic Messages has a different private continuation shape; parity is intentionally enforced on the shared frozen assertions and protocol metrics, while opaque roundtrip is asserted independently for each dialect.

NativeProviderLiveRunner derives repetition from the fixed harness's documented case-major sequential invocation order; changing runner invocation order would require an explicit repetition argument in the evaluator contract, which is outside this ticket's ownership.
